title: A Joomla contract profile whose plain release download fails is fetched through the GitHub API asset route, and a failed fetch names its reason on /ops
steps: S1: Run the Joomla contract fetch test of packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation (stand-in ContractFetch and stand-in downloads: the plain release address fails, the API lists the asset).
expect: S1: all tests pass: the provisioner hands ContractFetch tracy_contract_download; a failed plain download is retried once at the releases/assets address with Accept application/octet-stream and the same size and sha256; a working plain download asks no API; a refusal is one `!! contract-fetch:` line.
evidence: The JA Voyara 1.0.12 demo update on dev failed with only `contract profile ja-voyara/j6/1.0.12: not on disk`; the fetch's own reason was hidden by the shell line after it, and the profile fetch had no fallback for the github.com release download route that answered 504 the same day
fence: PHP against stand-in fetcher and downloads; no network, no database
